blocks.text: The workers are the people who are the first to come to the church on Sunday morning. For example, they would have been there an hour before others come. They must wake up early on Sunday morning in order to see that they are there early. As far as workers are concerned, the whole Sunday belongs to Jesus Christ. When they finish their morning prayers they must go on house to house witnessing or follow-up in order to invite people to the church. In the evening, they are expected to be at the House-fellowship Centres and the monthly Holy Communion Services.
